lineage: Actual train006 update200; preserve all learned state through explicitly versioned migration owned by restart_registry and root.
proposal: Each scheduled shared-model proposal starts at configured base LR and retries base, half, quarter, eighth. Reuse identical clipped gradients; deep-copy restore all model and Adam state plus RNG before every trial. Accept only full-actor analytic KL(old collected Gaussian || candidate) averaged over the complete fixed rollout <= target .02. Exhaustion restores last accepted state and disables remaining shared-model steps in that rollout. Restore base LR at update end.
normalizers: Preserve loaded actor mean/variance/count exactly during collection; critic and AMP statistics continue their original schedules. Do not swap/reset the learned actor statistics.
discriminator: Unchanged original schedule, loss, rate and state; all20 scheduled discriminator minibatches continue.
zero_accepted: Null PPO-only mean metrics; increment persisted streak; checkpoint and learning diagnostic stop after3 consecutive zero-accepted updates. This is not a physical gate.
not_adopted: Task reward, physics, curriculum, or physical-gate changes
strict_migration: No silent source/schema loader bypass; root independently reviews and freezes successor before migration/native dispatch.
